title: Crowd Booing
blurb: Democracy's oldest review system, delivered at stadium scale and with real conviction. Booing is remarkable because it is entirely collective — one person booing is an embarrassment, ten thousand is a verdict — and this crowd has clearly made up its mind. Play it after bad puns, worse decisions, and anybody suggesting the meeting run over. It functions as the exact counterweight to the cheering crowd: same arena, same people, opposite ruling. The public has considered the matter and has come back negatively.
origin: Stadium crowd booing — mass disapproval, instantly.
